title: H3 AI Influencer
description: Animates your image as the first frame: a talking-head, vlog or podcast shot. Add a voice track and the lips follow it.

labels.1:image: First frame: your image (<Picture 1> in the prompt)
labels.70:audio: Voice track (the lips follow this audio, or the sound of a video)
labels.100:value: Describe the motion, the speech and the sound. Refer to your image as <Picture 1>.

choices.label: Off
choices.hint: the model writes the voices from the prompt

choices.label: On
choices.hint: the lips follow the audio file you add

hints: Write the timeline of the shot in the prompt: who speaks when, and what they say in quotes.
With a voice track, keep one speaker per clip and say who is speaking in the prompt.
5-6 s clips give the steadiest faces. For longer videos use Long video, which chains clips.
Use an image of at least 1024 px with no watermark or text on it.
